# Psychedelics Knowledge Graph

> A living, provenance-rich map of psychedelic research for human exploration and read-only use by applications and AI agents.

The project separates primary studies, meta-analyses, and reviews. Finding rows
are not independent studies; use distinct study counts for evidence-volume
comparisons. Cite DOI, evidence location, result direction, and active release ID
when using evidence from the graph.

## Agent and data access

- [Agent access guide](https://psychedelicskg.com/developers/agent-guide.md): Concise machine-readable instructions, endpoints, tool inventory, and evidence semantics.
- [Human data and API guide](https://psychedelicskg.com/developers/): REST, MCP, and bulk-download documentation with live release status.
- [OpenAPI schema](https://psychedelics-kg-api.onrender.com/openapi.json): Machine-readable REST contract.
- [Interactive API reference](https://psychedelics-kg-api.onrender.com/docs): Browser-based endpoint documentation.
- [MCP server](https://psychedelics-kg-api.onrender.com/mcp): Public read-only Streamable HTTP Model Context Protocol endpoint.
- [Active release metadata](https://psychedelics-kg-api.onrender.com/api/v1/meta): Release ID, row counts, scopes, and counting warnings.
- [Public query schema](https://psychedelics-kg-api.onrender.com/api/v1/schema): Tables, fields, and interpretation metadata.

## Human-facing project documentation

- [Interactive graph](https://psychedelicskg.com/): Navigate evidence by compound, domain, and canonical entity.
- [About](https://psychedelicskg.com/about/): Purpose and intended use of the project.
- [Methods](https://psychedelicskg.com/methods/): Literature discovery, screening, extraction, validation, and updating methods.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/povilaskarvelis/psychedelics_knowledge_graph): Open-source pipeline and technical documentation.

## Optional

- [Feedback](https://psychedelicskg.com/feedback/): Report missing evidence, errors, access problems, or suggestions privately.
